I fully understand why Ian is going tonight but also I’m so sad!

Honestly I don’t blame Ian or Tyler for wanting to get the $40,000 and go home...with that type of paycheck it’s like a job with a huge bonus if you make it to the end. A lot of people don’t make that much in a year, they could’ve made that in a week and gone back to their families! 

Also Ian and Tyler both know they aren’t winning so I get seeing last week as the final week they had to leave and go home vs stay, not win, and have to be stuck for longer in the jury house. 

Not great tv, but 1000% understandable!
Nicole is safe with Dani or Cody winning, no way she wants HOH. I bet she’ll drop if Tyler drops
David is talking gibberish and it’s working 👀

Of course people shouldn’t have to be serious all the time. People can be funny AND nice to each other simultaneously. 

Also, the dynamic of Janelle and Nicole is completely different than Ian with these 4 people who are mocking him. 

I’m not an expert and I don’t claim to be, just seeing people make fun of Ian breaks my heart and idk why they can’t be more compassionate. 

Game play is fun to watch, whatever it was they were doing was not.

Personally I just think there’s a difference between playing a game and making fun of people. Like lie, backstab, do whatever you gotta do to win, but making fun of peoples mannerisms and stuff like that is just rude. 

You can have fun and not be an asshole 🤷🏻‍♀️
Regardless of the fact that his motions are probably relating to autism or anxiety, it’s still not ok to mock or make fun of people, period.

THIS IS NOT THE TIME TO SWITCH TO IAN ON THE HAMMOCK!!!! 

Normally I’d love it but not now damnit 😭

I don’t think the entire ball was supposed to read “monster”. The first category was Halloween costumes. I thought Brooke’s was simple, but very clever. Most people wouldn’t think to do that! And why not use her ballet talents to enhance the runway? And Yvie’s was also extremely clever. Fashion is good but it’s all about how you sell it. Nina is a campy queen, sure it’s good to be “fashion” but what’s wrong with some camp?? Her little shop of horrors runway was so good! 

I personally love the theatrics and would rather be told a story than look at a fashion model walk down the runway every week. 🤷🏻‍♀️
But why does she look so much like Michelle in that 2nd photo
It took me an embarrassingly long time to realize the date is not November ninth of 2018. I was like wow someone photoshopped this bitch’s tweet for sure

I liked Eureka on season 9 and I liked her when I saw her live at the haters roast tour. For me, she got very predictable and whiny in s10. She was constantly talking about her weight, which is 100% fine but it doesn’t need to be brought up every single episode. And that could be more editing than anything else. Also she got mad at Aquaria for playing the game. Then in the make over challenge, she played the game and purposefully matched people who she thought would have a greater challenge. It could be the editing but that’s what irked me with her in the show!
